core_meaning.primary_meaning: Akbar corresponds to the Arabic form أكبر and is glossed in this record as “Greatest.” The record associates the form with root ك ب ر (k-b-r). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Akbar corresponds to the Arabic form أكبر (Arabic root ك ب ر (k-b-r); أَكْبَر (ʾakbar)). Its core sense is greatest. Akbar is Arabic أَكْبَر (ʾakbar) 'Greatest', the elative ('greater, greatest') form built on the root ك ب ر (k-b-r).

etymology.morphology: Elative adjective (afʿal pattern) built on the root ك ب ر.
etymology.etymological_meaning: From the root ك ب ر (k-b-r)
etymology.etymology_explanation: The form أكبر is an established Arabic lexical item — the elative of the root ك ب ر — and Akbar is the word itself used as a personal name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.

islamic_naming_context.important_distinction: Muslim use of the name is not evidence that the word is Qur'anic or religiously prescribed.

urdu.name: اکبر
urdu.meaning: سب سے بڑا، سب سے زبردست
urdu.long_meaning: Akbar (اکبر) عربی زبان سے ماخوذ نام ہے۔ اس کا بنیادی مفہوم سب سے بڑا، سب سے زبردست ہے۔ یہ نام مسلم معاشروں میں رکھا جاتا ہے اور اس کے مفاہیم سیاق و سباق کے مطابق استعمال ہوتے ہیں۔

persian.name: أكبر
persian.long_meaning: Akbar (أكبر) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن بزرگترین، برترین است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: अकबर
hindi.long_meaning: Akbar (अकबर) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ सबसे बड़ा, सर्वशक्तिमान है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

pashto.name: اکبر
pashto.long_meaning: Akbar (اکبر) د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی او بنسټیزه مانا یې تر ټولو لوی، ځواکمن ده. دا نوم په مسلمانانو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او کارونه یې د سیاق له مخې بدلیږي.

arabic.name: أكبر
arabic.long_meaning: Akbar (أكبر) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة العربية، ومعناه الأساسي أكبر، أعظم. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.

faq.q: What is the origin of Akbar?

faq.q: What is the root of Akbar?
faq.a: It is built on the root ك ب ر (k-b-r).
Akbar is used by Muslims, but it is a lexical name rather than an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Akbar is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name.

faq.q: What does Akbar mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu it is written اکبر and carries the sense “سب سے بڑا، سب سے زبردست”.

faq.q: Is Akbar a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records Akbar as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
